$comment: Which studies the README's results section is allowed to draw from. Everything under bench/results/ is published; this file decides what counts as a HEADLINE claim. A single batch is not enough - the bar set in Amendment 3 is the direction repeating across independent batches, and the effect published is the range across them. scripts/build-charts.mjs reads this file and will write nothing if a study is not listed here.
